title: Payoff Relief for Comfort Club Members — Home Comfort Financing
content:
*Payoff desk note — Comfort Club members paying off Home Comfort Financing.*

**Basis.** The payoff member relief is 15 percent when the borrower's Comfort Club agreement is active and has run at least 5 consecutive terms, 8 percent when that agreement is active and has run fewer than 5 consecutive terms, and zero when the borrower holds no active Comfort Club agreement. The agreement's status and consecutive terms are read from the borrower's Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements record.

**Effect.** The payoff per-diem rate is the starting rate reduced once by the payoff relief percentage, which is the payoff reliefs added together; the reliefs never act one after another. The payoff member relief is one of those reliefs.

## Basis Q&A

**The borrower's agreement is active and in its 5th consecutive term. Which relief?** 15 percent — 5 is at least 5.

**The agreement is active and in its 3rd consecutive term?** 8 percent.

**The borrower held an agreement for 9 terms but it is no longer active?** Zero: the relief rests on an active agreement.

**What does a 15 percent relief do to a starting rate of 7.99 percent, with no other payoff relief?** 7.99 multiplied by 85 and divided by 100: 6.7915 percent, unrounded.
